w10_T4_004061: Pia's youth bank account held 63 dollars at the start of the month. She withdrew 23 dollars for a concert ticket and, a week later, another 23 dollars for a birthday present. The bank then paid 7 dollars of interest into the account. Under its youth savings promotion the bank made whatever balance remained 3 times as large. How many dollars are in Pia's account now?
w10_T4_004063: Owen keeps a pile of bottle caps that was empty at the start of the month. He added 56 caps to it in each of 4 weeks. His sister Ivy, who had gathered only 65 caps, far fewer than Owen, gave him all of hers. A collector at the flea market then offered Owen 2 rare caps for every cap in his pile, and Owen swapped the whole pile. A second collector offered 3 caps for each cap he now had, and Owen swapped everything again. How many bottle caps are in Owen's pile now?
w10_T4_004065: Jae keeps a study timer in minutes, though her school reports study time in hours and she knows sixty minutes make an hour. On Monday her timer started with 134 minutes of planned study. In the morning she used 55 minutes on chemistry, in the afternoon 60 minutes on history, and in the evening 10 minutes on vocabulary. Her tutor then added 56 minutes of extra review to what remained on the timer and told her that this final amount is what she should study on each of the next 8 evenings. How many minutes will Jae study over those 8 evenings?
w10_T4_004071: Nadia bought 8 packs of stickers; each pack holds 9 sheets and each sheet has 147 stickers, and those stickers became her whole collection. She divided the collection equally among 6 people, herself included, and kept only her own share as her collection. She then used 852 stickers from her collection to decorate a notebook. A sticker club offered 9 new stickers for every sticker turned in, and Nadia turned in her entire remaining collection for new ones. Her class has 27 students. She then gave 4634 stickers to the classroom craft box. How many stickers does Nadia have now?
w10_T4_004074: Lena's quiz team earned 48 points in the opening round, and the points were shared equally among the 6 team members as their personal scores. In the second round, which lasted half an hour, Lena added 54 points to her score. In the third round she added 34 more. Lena then scored exactly that same weekly total in each of the 9 weeks of the league season. How many points did Lena score over the whole season?
w10_T4_004077: A school canteen measures rice in grams even though it orders by the kilogram, since a thousand grams make a kilogram. Each portion starts with 173 grams of rice, then the cook adds 15 grams of peas and 15 grams of chopped carrot. Every pot holds 8 such portions, the canteen cooks 5 pots a day, and this week it cooked for 4 days. The cook also set aside 57 grams of the mixture for tasting, which counts toward the total. Half the students choose the rice option. How many grams of the rice mixture did the canteen prepare this week in total?
w10_T4_004080: A tour company sends coaches to the coast each morning. Today each coach left with 126 passengers, picked up 43 more at the station, and dropped 79 off at the harbour, and that was the load on each of the 4 coaches that ran. At the coast all of the passengers from those 4 coaches were divided equally among 4 hotels. The Beacon Hotel, one of them, also took in 38 walk-in guests that evening, after a wait of half an hour at the desk. How many guests did the Beacon Hotel take in that day?
w10_T4_004082: Carla saves coins in a tin and counts them in cents, though her bank statement will show dollars and she knows a hundred cents make a dollar. She put 197 cents into the tin in each of 4 weeks. Her brother Dev had saved only 74 cents in that time, far less than Carla, and he tipped all of it into her tin for her birthday. She then found 57 cents in a coat pocket and added it, and her grandmother, who has kept a coin tin for a dozen years, gave her 73 cents. How many cents are in Carla's tin now?
w10_T4_004083: The community hall keeps its folding chairs in a storeroom, which held 141 chairs on Monday. The hall can seat 300 people when full. On Tuesday 59 chairs were lent to the school, and on Wednesday 41 of them came back. The caretaker found 5 chairs in the boiler room and added them to the storeroom. A delivery of 67 chairs arrived on Thursday, and the committee bought 75 more on Friday. Over the weekend 86 chairs were given to the new church hall. How many chairs are in the storeroom now?
w10_T4_004086: Ms. Ruiz keeps the pencil supply for her school. Each box the supplier sends holds 196 pencils, and the supplier tucks 16 extra pencils into every box as a bonus. She received 5 such boxes, which made up the whole supply. The school has 22 classrooms. A teacher then returned 77 unused pencils from last term, and a parent donated 19 more. How many pencils are in the supply now?
w10_T4_004087: On Monday morning Farmer Luca planted 89 seedlings in each row of his fields, which he has worked for a dozen years. By midday the morning sun had killed 30 seedlings in every row. In the afternoon rabbits ate 37 seedlings from each row. In the evening Luca replanted 10 seedlings in every row. Each field has 8 rows planted this way, and Luca has 5 such fields. How many seedlings are standing across all of Luca's fields?
w10_T4_004090: The Rialto theatre keeps a stock of printed programmes. The printer delivered 6 boxes with 102 programmes in each, and that was the whole stock. A leak in the storeroom ruined 96 programmes, which were thrown out. An usher then returned 17 programmes that had been left on seats, and they went back into the stock. With a long run of shows ahead, the manager ordered a reprint that tripled the stock. How many programmes are in the stock now?
w10_T4_004091: Nora tracks her reading in minutes, though her reading app reports hours and she knows sixty minutes make an hour. On Sunday she read for 84 minutes, split equally among 6 books. For her weekday plan she decided to read each book for 5 minutes less than that Sunday share, to read 3 books in every session, and to have 2 sessions a day. The library lets her borrow up to 10 books at a time. She followed the plan for 9 days. How many minutes did Nora read over those 9 days?
w10_T4_004097: In the morning 8 boxes of floor tiles, each holding 162 tiles, arrived at a renovation site, and the tiles were shared equally among the 4 tilers working there. In the afternoon the foreman gave Ana, one of the tilers, 40 extra tiles from the van. Ana laid all of her tiles in 4 equal rows across the hallway floor, which took her half an hour. The hallway is 5 metres wide. In the evening she measured the next room and found it would need 7 rows of exactly the same size as those hallway rows. How many tiles does Ana need for the next room?
w10_T4_004100: The Oakfield food drive opened in the morning with 76 tins already on the table, and 49 more tins arrived before noon. In the afternoon a scout troop brought 48 tins, and a neighbour who had walked half a mile with a heavy bag added 10. In the evening the last delivery brought 66 tins. How many tins did the food drive collect in total?
w10_T4_004101: A courier named Bashir drives 54 kilometres a day on his rural route and did that for 7 days straight. One day a road closure added a 16-kilometre detour to that week's total. The following week he drove exactly the same again, so his two-week total was 2 times the first week. His odometer records in metres rather than kilometres, so he keeps in mind that a thousand metres make a kilometre. When he transferred the log, a faulty cable dropped 633 kilometres from the total, and he then added back 7 kilometres from a receipt he found. How many kilometres does Bashir's log show now?
w10_T4_004107: Jess and Cal were making bread and measured in grams, though the recipe was written in kilograms and they knew a thousand grams make a kilogram. Jess put 156 grams of flour into the bowl and Cal stirred in 38 grams of seeds, so Jess contributed more to the bowl than Cal did. They made 2 bowls exactly like that and combined them into one big batch. They divided the batch equally into 4 loaves. Their cafe then ordered 7 loaves of exactly that size for the weekend. How many grams of dough do Jess and Cal need for the cafe order?
w10_T4_004108: Each of the 9 campers at Pine Lake started Saturday morning with 230 cents of tuck-shop money, and every camper spent it in exactly the same way. In the morning each spent 193 cents on a sandwich and then 16 cents on a stamp. In the afternoon the camp leader made each camper's remaining money 2 times as large as a reward for a tidy cabin. In the evening each camper spent 39 cents on hot chocolate. The tuck shop keeps its accounts in dollars rather than cents, and the leader knows that a hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents do the 9 campers have left altogether?
w10_T4_004112: A resort kitchen counts the breakfasts it serves. On the first morning 165 guests came down, then 62 more arrived from a late coach, and 16 staff members also ate. Then 7 guests sent their plates back untouched and were taken off the count, while 25 day visitors bought breakfast at the door. The kitchen served exactly that same number of breakfasts on each of 9 mornings, and the head cook spent half an hour each day writing up the tally. How many breakfasts did the kitchen serve over the 9 mornings?
w10_T4_004122: On the morning of the fair Ines had 121 balloons ready, but 43 popped in the heat before the gates opened. Her helper Kofi arrived with 57 balloons of his own, fewer than Ines had started with, and added them to her bunch. In the afternoon they handed 132 balloons to children over half an hour. In the evening Ines inflated 75 more for the fireworks crowd. How many balloons does Ines have now?
w10_T4_004124: Mira busks in the subway and counts her takings in cents, though the busking permit fee is quoted in dollars and she knows a hundred cents make a dollar. On Monday she earned 222 cents in each of 5 hours of playing, and then some passers-by dropped in 23 cents, 24 cents and 37 cents as she packed up. Her guitar has 6 strings. She spent 698 cents on dinner on the way home. Mira ended each of 7 days with exactly the same amount as Monday and saved all of it. How many cents did she save over those 7 days?
w10_T4_004127: The Westbrook school counts every book it owns. Each classroom started the year with 202 books and received 76 more from the district, and there are 7 classrooms stocked exactly that way, which made up the entire count. The school building has 3 floors. The librarian then added 67 reference books to the count, and a parent donated 24 picture books. How many books does the school own now?
w10_T4_004132: The new Riverside stadium has 201 seats in each block, 4 blocks in each stand, and 8 stands around the pitch. The club also fitted 14 seats in the press box, 78 seats in the hospitality suite and 26 seats in the family lounge. The stadium opened 30 years after the old ground was built, and half of the seats are painted blue. How many seats does the stadium have in total?
w10_T4_004140: Tess had 167 tulip bulbs in her shed. She gave 122 of them to the school garden, and 40 more rotted over the winter. In spring she planted every bulb she had left, and each one multiplied into 5 bulbs by the time she dug them up. Her neighbour Marta gave her 27 bulbs, which was fewer than the 59 bulbs Tess bought at the nursery a week later, and both lots went into the shed with the rest. The shed has stood for a dozen years. The following spring each bulb in the shed again multiplied into 5 bulbs. How many tulip bulbs does Tess have now?
w10_T4_004141: In the morning each press in the print room was fed 8 reams of 197 sheets and spat out 52 jammed sheets, and that gave its hourly output, which it kept up for 9 hours. In the afternoon the manager counted the output of the 6 presses that had run exactly like that. The whole output was divided equally among 3 clients. In the evening one client, Dana, used 10637 of her sheets for a mailing, while another client, Eli, used none of his, so Eli had more sheets left than Dana. How many sheets does Dana have left?
